market_monitor.universe_rule: For each session d: eligible = common stocks (cs-universe) with a bar on d and >= 15 bars in the 20 sessions ending d; ranked by mean(close*volume) over those bars; universe(d) = top 3000. Counts are over universe(d). Sessions = dates with bars (market-closed days excluded); prior session = previous session in that list. LIMITATION: the cs-universe roster is a single list as of a later date (see universe_roster_as_of) applied to every historical session, not point-in-time membership; delisted/renamed names are absent, so survivorship bias is possible in historical breadth and the after-similar-days selection.

definitions.source_note: Source: Stockbee 2011 TC2000 scan code. Quarter and 34-day = 100*((C+0.01)-(MINC+0.01))/(MINC+0.01) vs the lowest (up) or highest (down) close of the complete window; month 25%/50% = 100*(C-C20)/C20 with a $5.00 floor on the old close; every quarter/month/34-day scan also needs 20-day average close x average volume >= $250,000. Stockbee published only the UP month scans: the down-month scans (25%/50%) are our mirror of them and are UNVERIFIED. Universe differs (top 3000 by 20-day dollar volume vs Worden all common stocks), so counts run lower than his sheet.
definitions.ext_n: Universe stocks with a warm extension reading (15+ bars, no reset), close >= $1.00 and close*volume >= $2,000,000
definitions.ext_above2: Of ext_n, count with extension >= +2.0 (extension = (close - EMA8) / Wilder ATR14, in ATR units)
definitions.up4: Stocks up 4%+ on the day: C >= 1.04*C1, volume > prior-session volume, volume >= 100,000
definitions.down4: Stocks down 4%+ on the day: C <= 0.96*C1, volume > prior-session volume, volume >= 100,000
definitions.ratio5: Sum of up4 over last 5 sessions / sum of down4 over last 5 sessions (null if denominator 0)
definitions.up25q: Quarter (65 sessions): 100*((C+0.01)-(MINC65+0.01))/(MINC65+0.01) >= 25, MINC65 = lowest close of the 65 sessions ending today (needs all 65 closes); 20-day avg close x avg volume >= $250,000 (needs all 20 bars with close and volume)
definitions.down25q: Quarter (65 sessions): the same measure against MAXC65 (highest close) <= -25 (needs all 65 closes); 20-day avg close x avg volume >= $250,000 (needs all 20 bars)
definitions.up25m: Month: 100*(C-C20)/C20 >= 25 (up 25%+), C20 = close 20 sessions ago >= $5.00; 20-day avg close x avg volume >= $250,000 (needs all 20 bars)
definitions.down25m: Month: 100*(C-C20)/C20 <= -25 (down 25%+), C20 >= $5.00; 20-day avg close x avg volume >= $250,000. Mirror of Stockbee's up scan, UNVERIFIED
definitions.up50m: Month: 100*(C-C20)/C20 >= 50 (up 50%+), C20 >= $5.00; 20-day avg close x avg volume >= $250,000
definitions.down50m: Month: 100*(C-C20)/C20 <= -50 (down 50%+), C20 >= $5.00; 20-day avg close x avg volume >= $250,000. Mirror of Stockbee's up scan, UNVERIFIED
definitions.up13_34: 34 sessions: 100*((C+0.01)-(MINC34+0.01))/(MINC34+0.01) >= 13 (needs all 34 closes); 20-day avg close x avg volume >= $250,000 (needs all 20 bars)
definitions.down13_34: 34 sessions: the same measure against MAXC34 <= -13 (needs all 34 closes); 20-day avg close x avg volume >= $250,000 (needs all 20 bars)
definitions.t2108: % of universe stocks (with 40 closes in the last 40 sessions) whose close is above their 40-session simple average, 1 decimal
definitions.t2108_n: Number of universe stocks eligible for t2108
definitions.universe_n: Number of stocks in the day's universe

forward_iwm.note: Past sessions (excluding the newest) with full forward data whose per-row percentile (vs its own trailing window, earlier sessions only) falls in today's 20-point band. Changes are close-to-close %.
forward_iwm.overlap_note: Samples overlap: a 5-session forward window starting on consecutive sessions shares sessions with its neighbours. n = sessions matched; n_independent = a non-overlapping subset (start sessions at least 5 apart).
